evidence.title: Trump establishes committee to investigate Fed governor Lisa Cook
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Trump said a committee will consult with justice department officials to decide whether there is “cause” for her removal. [e001:f02] The White House will hold an in-person hearing on 5 November to consider the allegations against Cook, which will be closed to the public but transcribed and published. [e001:f03] Cook will be able to submit a written statement to present her own evidence and will be subject to examination from White House and her own legal counsel. [e001:f04] “As President, it is my job to ensure the laws are faithfully executed, including by firing subordinates who cannot be trusted to tell the truth and follow the law,” Trump said in a statement posted to the White House’s website. [e001:f05] In response to the announcement, Cook’s lawyers said that they had “grave doubts” that the White House hearing would be “a legitimate one that would conform to the law”. [e001:f06] “But if it is anything close to objective,” they continued, “the conclusion will be that Governor Cook did not commit mortgage fraud, leaving no cause to remove her from the Federal Reserve Board.” They added that Cook “welcomes the opportunity to present the facts so she can clear her name and demonstrate there is no legal basis to fire her”. [e001:f07] Cook was appointed by Joe Biden in 2022 to a 14-year term, becoming the Fed’s first Black governor. [e001:f08] Cook’s battle with the White House began in August 2025 when she was abruptly fired after Trump said she committed mortgage fraud by listing two properties in Georgia and Michigan as her primary residence and failing to report rental income on her Atlanta property. [e001:f09] Cook immediately sued the Trump administration , and the supreme court reinstated her after a 5-4 ruling that she could stay on as governor while fighting the fraud allegations. [e001:f10] In June, the court ruled that Trump’s firing was unconstitutional because he did not follow proper procedure and give Cook an opportunity to dispute the allegations before she was fired. [e001:f11] Cook was fired just as Trump was launching unprecedented attacks on the Fed’s chair, then Jerome Powell, in his blustering push to get the central bank to lower interest rates. [e001:f12] Trump also launched a justice department investigation into Powell, which was dropped in April. [e001:f13] Congress created the Fed to be an independent and non-partisan institution. [e001:f14] Economists widely agree that a central bank unswayed by politics is essential for the stability of a country’s economy. [e001:f15] Kevin Warsh, Powell’s successor, has repeatedly faced questions over how he will maintain the Fed’s independence. [e001:f16] But because of elevated inflation brought on by the war in the Middle East, the bank ultimately voted to raise rates in its last meeting, which drew the ire of the White House just more than a month before the crucial midterm elections.

One Trading secures strategic investment from Nasdaq Ventures
evidence.body: [e004:f01] The investment reflects Nasdaq Ventures’ focus on investing in technologies that can support the continued modernisation of global capital markets, and establishes a foundation for Nasdaq and One Trading to explore future areas of collaboration. [e004:f02] One Trading’s unified deterministic trading, risk and settlement platform is designed to support cross-collateral netting, continuous settlement, and auto-liquidations at scale. [e004:f03] This results in less locked margin and eliminates the need for a mutualised default fund. [e004:f04] The platform combines features associated with digital asset markets, including 24/7 trading and auto-liquidations, with the protections and transparency of a regulated European trading venue. [e004:f05] Joshua Barraclough, CEO of One Trading said, “Nasdaq Ventures shares our belief that markets must continue to evolve to better support clients’ liquidity and capital needs. [e004:f06] We believe the future of derivatives markets will be shaped by advances in technology, risk management and market infrastructure that make markets more efficient, responsive and resilient. [e004:f07] Together, we see an opportunity to explore new approaches to derivatives innovation and help define the next generation of market infrastructure.” Alongside the investment, Nasdaq and One Trading are exploring opportunities to bring together Nasdaq’s experience in developing advanced market infrastructure, global distribution and client relationships with One Trading’s cloud-deployed low-latency trading and risk engine, along with their unique regulatory position in the EU. [e004:f08] As part of the collaboration, the companies will evaluate opportunities to modernise derivatives market infrastructure and expand the suite of products available to market participants, including long-dated futures. [e004:f09] Gary Offner, Global Head of Nasdaq Ventures said, “At Nasdaq Ventures, we look for teams building disruptive technologies that are uniquely positioned to expand liquidity and transparency while addressing market participants’ needs — advancing the modernisation of capital markets. [e004:f10] One Trading has developed a differentiated approach to integrating trading, risk management and settlement, and we believe the company is well positioned to play an important role in the evolution of derivatives markets.” About One Trading One Trading is a European trading platform headquartered in the Netherlands and the EU’s first trading venue authorized under both MiFID II and MiCAR. [e004:f11] The platform offers institutional and eligible retail clients 24/7 access to regulated, cash-settled futures across crypto and now equities. [e004:f12] Gerald Segal Gerald is one of the most experienced writers covering the online trading sector. [e004:f13] Prior to starting FNG, Gerald founded Forex industry news website in 2010, selling it in 2018 to publicly traded Catena Media plc (STO:CTM). [e004:f14] An avid skier, cyclist and ice hockey player, Gerald was previously an investment banker for more than a decade at Bear Stearns, Robertson Stephens, and Merrill Lynch. [e004:f15] Gerald holds an MBA from Columbia University in New York and a BCOM degree from the University of Toronto. previous_updates.title: Nasdaq、Nasdaq-100イベント契約を第4四半期に投入へ
previous_updates.summary: NasdaqはSECの承認を受け、Nasdaq-100指数を参照するイベント契約を2026年第4四半期に投入する計画を示した。 指数事業は第2四半期に34商品を新規投入し、このうち17商品が海外向け、11商品が機関投資家向け年金分野だった。 直近12カ月の純資金流入の38％は過去5年以内、22％は過去3年以内に投入した商品が生み、12月6日には23時間・週5日取引の開始も予定する。
